reason: Our fees run fine in Tally and Excel, notices go on WhatsApp, and we have never paid for school software. I am not taking Rs 60,000 plus GST to the trustees for something new from a company I have never heard of, half-price offer or not.
objection: Migrating 1,500-plus students' data and retraining staff mid-session is a big headache, and if this new company shuts down or the fee module does not match our Tally ledgers, I am the one who answers to the trustees.
would_change_my_mind: A principal from a nearby CBSE school I know telling me they have run their fees and timetable on it for a full year without trouble, plus someone coming to set it up and import our Tally data for us.
